'''Hhalyia Ahsane''' was the [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] and hostess of the [[Custom Stop]], a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] located just outside the [[Soco-Jarel Spaceport]]. Ahsane's origins were a mystery, popular speculation stated that she was formerly a [[Chef/Legends|chef]] for an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]], a retired [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], or a retired [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]].<ref name="BSS" />
